title: DIVINE SHELTER
IN EVERY STORM
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden light rays through thick clouds
still night forest with soft moonlight
calm ocean waves at golden hour

scenes.a: If the uncertainty of this specific hour feels like it is closing in, listen closely.
He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
Lord, in the middle of these shifting circumstances, let me know the weight of your protection.
Keep my spirit tethered to your faithfulness when the path ahead seems obscured by fear.
Let your truth act as the iron fortress that surrounds my mind and guards my peace.
May I rest completely in your presence, knowing I am held by your unchanging, mighty hand.
